pausetweaks.settings.height.name: 暂停界面高度
pausetweaks.settings.height.hint: 调整整个暂停弹窗的高度。（默认：50）

pausetweaks.settings.spindirection.name: 反转旋转动画

pausetweaks.settings.pulse.name: 禁用脉动动画
pausetweaks.settings.text.name: 暂停文字

pausetweaks.settings.img.name: 暂停图片
